title: Balinese Tofu Sando
subtitle: with Pickled Cucumber and Creamy Slaw
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Thinly slice the cucumber. Thinly slice the cabbage with a sharp knife or mandoline (see Kitchen 101). Peel the carrot, then shred using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater.
Pickle cucumber: Combine 2 tsp white vinegar and ½ tsp sugar in a large bowl. Add the cucumber and toss to combine. Set aside to pickle, tossing occasionally, until needed.

Warm tofu: Preheat the grill to high. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Add the ayam goreng paste and 1 tbs water and cook, turning, for 1 min or until coated in the paste. Remove the pan from the heat.

Toast rolls: Meanwhile, halve the bread rolls. Put on an oven tray, cut side up, and grill for 1-2 mins until lightly toasted. Combine 2 tbs mayonnaise and 2 tsp water in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the cabbage and carrot and toss to coat.
Serve up: Top the roll bases with half the slaw. Layer with the tofu and drained pickled cucumber. Sandwich with the roll tops and serve with the remaining slaw. Enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Get super-thin cabbage with a mandoline or use slow, fine strokes with a large sharp knife. The result is perfect for slaw – light, crisp and easy to eat.
